column1: # Where to go next for a quest, by hand: a row beats what the install says (crates/kotor-game/src/quest_route.rs).
# Columns, split by one tab: quest, state it is in now, module, kind (door elevator talk item area kill), target tag, label.
# An empty tag means go to the module. An empty label means the game's own name. Rows are ours, not the game's text.
